title: Every fixed rule row shows a category at both ends of the Category sort
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example 0000-ZZAUTOTEST-PCA08 first) exists.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example zzzz-ZZAUTOTEST-PCA08 last) exists.
  • Fixed rule part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA08-1) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-A} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • Fixed rule part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA08-2) is at {Location-A} in category {Category-B} with fixed price (for example 15.00).
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  4. Click the Category column header.
  5. Read the first row.
  6. Scroll to the end of the list.
  7. Read the last row.
  8. Click the Category column header again.
  9. Read the first row.
  10. Scroll to the end of the list.
  11. Read the last row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 5 and 7: the first row is {Part-A} in {Category-A} and the last row is {Part-B} in {Category-B}. No row has an empty Category cell.
  • Steps 9 and 11: the first row is {Part-B} in {Category-B} and the last row is {Part-A} in {Category-A}. No row has an empty Category cell.
  • Steps 4 to 11: a fixed rule whose part has no category cannot be created in the app, so the rule that an empty Category sorts last cannot be checked by hand. Write 'empty category: not checked by hand' in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-R12b, §4 Key Decisions (empty values sort last), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment: Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 882311473), third comment item 1: category-less rules stay unlisted, own ticket, not this release. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R12b: “The tab lists only fixed rules whose part has a category, as it does today. A fixed rule whose part has no category is not listed; across every shop in production that is 3 rules. Listing them would change what the server sends, which this PRD rules out, so they are left for a separate ticket. If an empty Category value ever does reach the list, it sorts last in the Category column in both directions.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions: “The Fixed Rules tab does not list those rules today and this PRD does not change that (S3-R12b), but the sort still treats an empty Category value as last so the rule holds if one ever reaches the list.”
